title: Mythic Suffixes
html:
Rainbow items keep a fixed base name. A rolled copy can also pick up one of these joke endings. The same ending always means the same bonus on that kind of gear. Brilliance (Do Not Remove Label) is just Brilliance plus the fighter-armor ending.

See Modifiers for how ordinary green / blue / yellow / purple names are stacked, and Name Descriptors for the Superior last word.
